title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Iowa on 1982-08-10
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Miller soundboard capture of a smoking August 1982 Iowa City show – tight playing, high energy and a standout Lost>Sailor>Saint>Eyes sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is a Miller‑masterpiece soundboard tape with crystal‑clear fidelity and only brief first‑set hiccups. The band is on fire – super tight throughout, delivering monster jams like the Lost Sailor > Saint of Circumstance > Eyes stretch and an inspired Iko Iko/Truckin' finale. Energy stays high from start to finish, making this one of the era’s most beloved performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star praise (10 of 12 reviews) for both performance and recording; minor dissent does not outweigh the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, top‑notch Miller soundboard mix; a few brief first‑set corrections mentioned but no significant dropouts or muffiness.

standout_songs: Lost Sailor > Saint of Circumstance > Eyes
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set with great song choices and a memorable I Need a Miracle > Bertha close; second set opens tightly with China/Rider and maintains momentum through the Lost/Saint/Eyes suite and a fiery Iko Iko/Truckin' finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Spot‑on guitar work throughout; the band was super tight and Jerry’s playing was praised as flawless.
band_member_comments.Bob: Unusual and inspired playing on Iko Iko noted by a reviewer.
